name: onco360-test-regles
description: Tests des règles de sécurité Firestore sur l'émulateur (Java 21 nécessaire)

scripts.test: cd ../.. && JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21) && PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH" firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-onco360 "$(which node) tests/regles/test-taches.mjs && $(which node) tests/regles/test-salle.mjs && $(which node) tests/regles/test-recus.mjs && $(which node) tests/regles/test-parametres.mjs && $(which node) tests/regles/test-rcp.mjs && $(which node) tests/regles/test-cabinets.mjs && $(which node) tests/regles/test-audit.mjs && $(which node) tests/regles/test-comptable.mjs && $(which node) tests/regles/test-bilan.mjs && $(which node) tests/regles/test-v1.mjs && $(which node) tests/regles/test-droits.mjs && $(which node) tests/regles/test-signataires.mjs && $(which node) tests/regles/test-ecoute.mjs && $(which node) tests/regles/test-rappels.mjs && $(which node) tests/regles/test-heure.mjs && $(which node) tests/regles/test-rtref.mjs && $(which node) tests/regles/test-remplacant.mjs"
scripts.export: cd ../.. && JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21) && PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH" firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage,functions --project demo-onco360 "$(which node) tests/emulateur/test-export.mjs"
scripts.modele: cd ../.. && JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21) && PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH" firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage,functions --project demo-onco360 "$(which node) tests/emulateur/test-modele.mjs"
